chunks: In fact, they deny what is beyond the reach of their knowledge, whose explanation has not reached them yet. So had those who have gone before them denied; but look at the fate of the unjust
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'ta'wil' in the context of Quranic denial in Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the distinction between superficial rejection and the eventual realization of divine truth through 'ta'wil' (unfolding of meaning), a concept central to understanding the Quran's deeper layers. It serves as a historical precedent, linking the disbelievers of Prophet Muhammad's time with earlier nations like those of Noah and Abraham, emphasizing that premature judgment leads to similar ruin. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on the necessity of patient contemplation and scholarly interpretation to grasp the full scope of revelation.
